messages.author: Yang Wei
messages.body:
Hi,
I'm currently working on training the force field for the dihedral angle of
the linker in PROTAC using "paramfits."
Following the fitting process, I observed that the phase of c3-n3-c3-h1
exceeds 360 degrees, and the periodicity of ca-ca-ca-ha (11.8743) and
os-c3-c3-hc (8.7931) is also significantly large. Is it considered normal
for the periodicity and phase to be large? Additionally, should periodicity
always be an integer value?
Could anyone help with this? I have attached the output file of paramfit
and fitted frcmod.
Thanks in advance,
Best,
Yang
